name: TeamSpeak 3
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: TeamSpeak 3 is a voice chat server known for clear audio and fine-grained permissions. Downloads the official server, which runs through Box64 on ARM64; starting it accepts TeamSpeak's licence agreement.
startup: run=; if [ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ]; then run=box64; fi; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.; exec $run ./ts3server license_accepted=1 default_voice_port={{SERVER_PORT}} voice_ip=0.0.0.0 query_port={{QUERY_PORT}} query_ip=0.0.0.0 filetransfer_port={{FILE_TRANSFER}} filetransfer_ip=0.0.0.0 query_http_port={{QUERY_HTTP}} query_ssh_port={{QUERY_SSH}} query_protocols={{QUERY_PROTOCOLS_VAR}} ${SERVERADMIN_PASSWORD:+serveradmin_password="$SERVERADMIN_PASSWORD"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TeamSpeak 3: downloads the TeamSpeak 3 server for Linux from
# teamspeak.com (the x86-64 build, which ARM64 servers run through the image's Box64),
# checked against the published SHA-256 for the current version. The
# database, uploaded files, licence key and query allow lists are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

latest=$(curl -fsSL https://teamspeak.com/versions/server.json) || { echo "Couldn't reach teamspeak.com to look up the version. Try again in a few minutes."; exit 1; }
version="${TS_VERSION:-latest}"
sha=""
if [ "$version" = latest ] || [ "$version" = "$(echo "$latest" | jq -r .linux.x86_64.version)" ]; then
    version=$(echo "$latest" | jq -r .linux.x86_64.version)
    sha=$(echo "$latest" | jq -r .linux.x86_64.checksum)
fi
url="https://files.teamspeak-services.com/releases/server/$version/teamspeak3-server_linux_amd64-$version.tar.bz2"
if [ "$(curl -sIL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")" != 200 ]; then
    echo "TeamSpeak 3 version $version doesn't exist: see https://teamspeak.com/en/downloads/#server."
    exit 1
fi

if [ -x ts3server ] && [ "$(cat .ts3-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "TeamSpeak 3 $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading TeamSpeak 3 $version."
    curl -fsSL -o $work/ts3.tar.bz2 "$url"
    if [ -n "$sha" ]; then
        echo "$sha  $work/ts3.tar.bz2" | sha256sum -c --quiet - || { echo "The download is damaged (checksum mismatch). Try again."; exit 1; }
    fi
    mkdir -p $work/ts3
    tar -xjf $work/ts3.tar.bz2 -C $work/ts3 --strip-components=1
    cp -a $work/ts3/. .
    echo "$version" > .ts3-version
fi
touch .ts3server_license_accepted
echo "Installed TeamSpeak 3 $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The TeamSpeak 3 server version to install, such as 3.13.9, or latest.

variables.name: Query password
variables.description: Sets the serveradmin query account's password at every start. Leave it empty to keep the one printed on the first start.

variables.name: File transfer port
variables.description: The port for file uploads and downloads in channels.

variables.name: Query protocols
variables.description: The ServerQuery protocols to turn on, separated by commas: raw, ssh and http.
